name: Manoah
summary: A man of Zorah, of the family of the Danites, whose wife had no children until the angel of the LORD promised them a son. That son was Samson.

key_moments.title: Prays for the Man of God to Return
key_moments.description: The angel of the LORD told Manoah's wife she would bear a son who would begin to deliver Israel from the Philistines. Manoah prayed for the man of God to come again and teach them how to raise the child, and the angel came back.

key_moments.title: Sees the Angel Rise in the Altar Flame
key_moments.description: Manoah offered a young goat on a rock to the LORD, and the angel went up in the flame of the altar. Manoah feared they would die because they had seen God, but his wife said the LORD would not have accepted their offering if He meant to kill them.
